## KaliScriber 0.3.4

Install the `arm64-v8a` APK on most phones (`universal` if unsure). It updates over earlier builds and keeps your meetings and settings.

### Speaker detection fixes
- **Speaker detection is no longer skipped.** The on-device speaker detection pack (45 MB) now downloads with your speech model. If it is still missing when a meeting ends, or when you tap **Re-detect speakers**, the app downloads it first instead of falling back to the AI. Before, a missing pack plus a slow AI call left everyone as one speaker.
- **"Everyone is under one speaker" card.** On a meeting that came out as one speaker, pick how many people were there and tap **Detect speakers**.
- **Long meetings.** Meetings over 20 minutes are now processed in blocks, and the same voice is matched across blocks. This keeps memory use low on hour-long meetings.
- **Lines split where the speaker changes.** With Parakeet models, a transcript line that holds a quick exchange is split between the two speakers at the right word.
- **AI speaker separation keeps going after a failure.** It retries a part that fails. If a part still fails, only that part's lines stay unassigned and the app says which.
